name: Marker Board
description: A clean whiteboard in a grey frame: black, blue, red and green marker doodles that draw themselves stroke by stroke, a visible marker pen following the tip, hand-drawn boxes, arrows, a red circle on the key idea and Caveat side notes.
best_use_cases: Step-by-step explanations drawn on a whiteboard
Teaching an idea in order, one stroke at a time
style: Hand-drawn marker on whiteboard; Permanent Marker titles, Caveat side notes; colour means things — black structure, blue labels, red key idea, green payoff.
